themes.description: Users report that the app’s chart screen frequently fails to load, stalls, or displays incorrect data, causing frustration and hindering trading decisions.
themes.business_impact: Repeated chart failures lead to missed trading opportunities, increased support tickets, and a higher likelihood of users switching to competitors, directly impacting revenue and user retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The recent app update likely introduced a regression in the chart rendering pipeline—perhaps due to incompatible API changes, data caching logic, or insufficient handling of mobile network variability—causing rendering delays and load failures.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Replicate failure scenarios in QA and identify failing network/data paths
• 2. Roll back recent chart module changes to a known stable baseline
• 3. Apply targeted fixes (e.g., async data fetching, graceful error handling, retry logic)
• 4. Deploy a canary release to monitor crash and error metrics
• 5. Conduct a post‑release review and update documentation for future releases
